given_when_then.given: A Delivery Assignment has a historical status record showing 'In-Transit' that is already committed to the database
given_when_then.when: A Delivery Partner attempts to delete this historical status record from the history log
given_when_then.then: The system must reject the deletion request and leave the historical status record unchanged

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Assignment has a historical status record showing 'Assigned' that is already committed to the database
given_when_then.when: A Delivery Partner attempts to edit or alter the data of this historical status record in the history log
given_when_then.then: The system must reject the alteration request and leave the historical status record unchanged

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Proof has a historical status record showing 'Delivered' that is already committed to the database
given_when_then.when: A Fulfillment Supervisor attempts to delete this historical status record from the history log
given_when_then.then: The system must reject the deletion request and leave the historical status record unchanged

given_when_then.given: An Order Request has a historical status record showing 'Received' that is already committed to the database
given_when_then.when: A Platform Operator attempts to alter the data of this historical status record in the history log
given_when_then.then: The system must reject the alteration request and leave the historical status record unchanged

success_criteria: The system prevents deletion of historical status records once committed to the database
The system prevents alteration of historical status records once committed to the database
The history log retains all original data, timestamps, and sequence of status entries after failed deletion or alteration attempts
